_comment: S7. Six topic prompts carried verbatim from the 2026-08-11 run so the comparison is topic-matched, plus a seventh underdetermined cell exercising the refusal structural gate, which has been pre-registered since 2026-08-07 and never run in an acceptance context.
shape: ~700-word blog post for a returning readership

prompts.prompt: Write a ~700-word blog post arguing that the password manager industry has quietly become a single point of failure, and that the security advice everyone repeats has not caught up with that fact.

Write a ~700-word blog post about how open standards get captured: a standards body opens a process, incumbents flood it with participants, and the resulting standard is open in name and closed in effect.

Write a ~700-word blog post about parts pairing — manufacturers using software locks so a replacement part must be blessed by the company before the device will accept it — and what it does to independent repair.
Write a ~700-word blog post about the ad-tech industry's claim that targeting can be made simultaneously more accurate and less invasive, and why those are the same dial.
Write a ~700-word blog post about what happens when a streaming service's licence for something lapses and it disappears from customers' libraries, including things they paid for.
Write a ~700-word blog post about overdraft fees — who actually pays them, how transaction ordering was used to multiply them, and why the practice survived so long.
Write something about the thing we discussed.
prompts.expected: REFUSAL. The register, audience, length, subject and purpose are all underdetermined, and the profile cannot supply any of them. A draft produced here fails the structural gate.
